Claude Code\\u0027s new mod system (panes, a band above the prompt, status line entries, toasts, slash commands, and hooks on tool calls and incoming messages) could make an orchestrator window much easier to work in, but Hall9k must never depend on a mod: every capability lives in Hall9k first and is exposed through a Hall9k API (CLI JSON output first, HTTP later for a browser consumer), and each vendor\\u0027s terminal tool consumes what it can. If a mod disappeared, Hall9k would lose convenience, never capability.
